title: IT / Finance / Security Weekly Ops Sync

Rhea Patel: Publish KMS rotation schedule and update runbook (due 2025-03-17)

Eli Turner: Confirm budget cadence and possible reallocation for Dedicated capacity (due 2025-03-19)

Security to run a dry-run of the evidence collection next Tuesday

transcript:
Meeting header:
2025-03-10 | 14:00 - 14:45 UTC | Duration: 45 minutes
Attendees: Sofia Alvarez, Eli Turner, Rhea Patel, Tom Brooks, Maya Chen

Summary: quick ops sync to align finance approvals, security evidence, and procurement for upcoming Dedicated GPU spend and pilot VPC peering.

00:00 Sofia: all right everyone, uh let's get started, thanks for joining on time, I know this one is cross-functional — we'll run through SOC 2, procurement, and the VPC pilot updates, quick status, actions, done.
00:27 Eli: yep, sounds good. quick note from finance side, we need a formal PO and vendor T&Cs by end of week, otherwise the payment run slides to next month, so that's kind of the gating item.
00:48 Tom: understood, i'm drafting a PO template, but i need the exact sku and expected monthly commit for the dedicated GPUs — is that finalized by infra?
01:05 Sofia: infra gave a ballpark, it's roughly 12 GPUs, M60-equivalent, expecting moderate burst. we still need to lock whether the pilot runs in dedicated or on our private offering, that impacts T&Cs.
01:30 Rhea: before we pick dedicated, we need to confirm the encryption at rest story and KMS integration — customers on Private require HSM-backed keys. what's the current plan for rotation?
01:50 Maya: compliance note — for SOC 2 evidence we need screenshots of key rotation policies and the actual rotation logs showing last 6 months, if possible.
02:10 Eli: ok, so finance needs to see that the vendor supports BYOK or integrates with our KMS, otherwise we'll have a hard time signing off.
02:30 Sofia: infra said vendor supports external KMS via customer-managed keys; Tom, can you confirm vendor doc link after this call and drop in the shared drive?
02:44 Tom: yes i will — may be a couple small typos in the doc, it's vendor-produced, so expect some inconsistencies. i'll upload and flag the specific SAML/SSO pages.
03:05 Rhea: speaking of SAML, we still need the SSO metadata exchange — security will run a test account. any idea on timeline?
03:20 Sofia: infra can provision test accounts tomorrow, Rhea, do you want me to loop them in?
03:30 Rhea: please do. also, i want to run a smoke test around audit logs — we need to ensure audit trails for admin actions are sent to our logging stack and retained per policy.
03:48 Maya: retention is a finance question too, because longer retention on observability increases cost; Eli, what flexibility do we have?
04:02 Eli: finance can approve a short-term increase for the pilot, but we need a spend forecast. can someone estimate additional monthly cost for 90-day vs 30-day retention?
04:22 Sofia: i'll get rough numbers from infra today, but my guess is 30% higher for 90 days because of indexing — i'll verify.
04:40 Tom: procurement question — do we need vendor SOC 2 Type II report? we should request it as part of procurement package.
04:55 Rhea: yes, request SOC 2 Type II and ISO where available. also whitepaper on network segmentation and VPC peering design for our legal/security review.
05:15 Eli: billing cadence: do we want monthly or net30? vendor prefers monthly invoicing, but our accounting prefers net30 for cashflow. we can do net30 if vendor accepts it.
05:35 Tom: i'll negotiate net30 but include an early-pay discount option — i'll put that in the template.
05:52 Sofia: back to KMS rotation — Rhea, did you propose a rotation schedule?
06:02 Rhea: current recommendation is 90-day rotation for symmetric keys and 1-year for master key wrapping, using HSM-backed KMS. i will document runbook and automation triggers.
06:20 Maya: capture the control IDs for SOC 2 — specifically CC6 and CC7 equivalents — so we can attach the evidence.
06:35 Rhea: noted, i'll map the controls and tag artifacts in the folder.
06:50 Eli: quick note on POs — finance needs the vendor legal name and W9 for US vendors, or equivalent tax docs for international. Tom, please collect.
07:05 Tom: on it. also, any special insurance requirements? some vendors ask for a certificate of insurance.
07:20 Maya: legal will confirm, but from compliance side we usually request cyber liability minimum, i'll confirm exact limits.
07:36 Sofia: VPC peering pilot — infra wants to peer with the us-west-2 pilot customer next week. we need a security sign-off and a short runbook documenting allowed subnets and ACLs.
07:55 Rhea: i'll review peering config, want to ensure routes are limited and logging enabled, shouldn't be broad.
08:10 Sofia: perfect. infra will provide the peering proposal by EOD tomorrow.
08:25 Eli: budgeting for pilot: if dedicated is confirmed, expected incremental monthly is about $45k for that cluster, does that match finance modeling?
08:39 Sofia: that's in line with infra estimate, but we can reduce by using mixed instance sizes or shorter commitment.
08:52 Eli: if we go with a 6-month reserved commitment, finance can amortize cost and it's easier to approve. short-term month-to-month is riskier.
09:07 Tom: procurement will prepare options: month-to-month, 6-month, and annual commit, with pricing differences.
09:20 Rhea: side item — access control: we need RBAC rules defined for admin vs infra engineers, so we don't end up with too-broad permissions when peering is established.
09:35 Maya: i can draft the RBAC matrix, map to HR roles, and we can align with engineering leads.
09:50 Sofia: great, please prioritize RBAC before peering.
10:02 Eli: invoice timing again — can procurement ensure the PO references the correct GL codes, else we hit reconciliation issues.
10:17 Tom: yes, i'll add GL code placeholders in the PO template and include a variable for project tag.
10:30 Rhea: anything else on SOC 2 evidence?
10:38 Maya: last bits: need employee attestations and periodic access review evidence, i've got most but two missing signatures which i'll chase.
10:52 Sofia: okay, team check: Tom — PO template and vendor docs by Friday; Rhea — KMS rotation runbook and RBAC matrix draft; Maya — finish evidence uploads and chase signatures; Eli — confirm budget and GL codes. sound right?
11:15 All: yes / sounds good / thanks.
11:30 Sofia: follow-ups — i'll create a short tracker in the shared drive with due dates and owners, and schedule the deep-dive for VPC peering for next Wednesday. Tom, please set invites.
11:50 Tom: will do.
12:05 Sofia: thanks everyone, meeting adjourned.

Notes: transcription contains a few vendor/product name approximations; speakers occasionally overlap. Links referenced (uploaded vendor docs, PO template) will be posted to the shared finance/ops folder after the call.

References mentioned in call:
- Vendor PO template (to be uploaded)
- KMS/HSM vendor docs (link pending)
